text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bosnia will not drop its war damages charges against rump Yugoslavia because the 1992-1995 conflict was not a civil war but a clear aggression, Bosnia's Vice President Ejup Ganic says at a meeting in Vienna with ambassadors from Islamic countries.
- A final decision on location of Bosnia's new three-man Presidency session should be reached on Monday, the newspaper says citing Bosnian government sources.

- Joint List BiH, the main opposition coalition in Moslem- Croat federation, is not ready to participate in forthcoming municipal election unless the pool of potential voters is defined, its representative Sejfudin Tokic says. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
